t_surface_limit_degC.source: Applicable standard clause and/or clinician. Governing: IEC 80601-2-35 (heating pads/blankets/mattresses) Table 201.102 'Temperature limits in dependency to time' (clause 201.11) - the table values must be read from the purchased standard before a value is set. IEC 60601-1 Table 24 (general applied-part skin-contact limit, 43 degC for >= 10 min) is a design reference only and is superseded by the particular standard. No value invented.
